text:
jamie_sales: Heads up — Lyric (prospect) wants to run a POC using a customer-converted Mistral variant (mistral-xxl-q4_kv). They need: catalog fit check, quant/kv cache compatibility, tokenizer/seq-length sanity, KMS + IP allowlist, and a ballpark dedicated pricing for a 2-week POC. Can ops/SE/security triage?

priya_se: Thanks! Quick asks — do we have the model artifact (gguf/pt) and tokenizer files? Also what latency SLO and RPS are they expecting? Function-calling or streaming required?

jamie_sales: They said GGUF exported from their pipeline and provide tokenizer.json. Target: p50 < 150ms for short prompts (~64 tokens), expected 20 qps burst (spiky), avg 5 rps. Streaming not required, need deterministic outputs for evals.

marco_infra: We support q4_kv on Triton/our runtime but customer-converted GGUF may need re-quant/packaging. Two quick checks: 1) confirm tokenizer matches vocab size, 2) run our kv cache test. Run this locally to sanity-check artifact:

```
python tools/convert_to_redwood.py --input model.gguf --out /tmp/mistral_redwood --quant q4_kv
redwood-runtime inspect /tmp/mistral_redwood --kv-test
```

If inspect fails, send me the GGUF and I can run trace.

priya_se: Also will run a quick catalog-scan in the onboarding tool — it checks ops compat, tokenizer mismatch, and known perf regressions. internal link: https://console.redwood.dev/model-scan?id=TEMP_TOKEN

elena_sec: Security flags: is Lyric sending production data? PHI/PII? For POC we need to know data residency and whether they want tokens redaction. KMS: we can support customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private, but hosted needs RBAC/KMS integration setup. Also need to confirm export-control restrictions on the model (customer-owned weights).

jamie_sales: POC will use synthetic and scrubbed customer prompts only. They want to use our Dedicated seat (monthly reserved) for 2 weeks of test. KMS will be customer key.

rachel_legal: If they're providing custom weights we need an executed MSA + weights attestation (export control). I'll ping legal intake but need customer contact and entity type. Can we keep the POC limited to a scoped SOW to avoid full onboarding?

marco_infra: FWIW fallback plan: if q4_kv conversion fails or latency SLO misses, we can route to mistral-33b-lite (quantized/verified) with minimal code changes. Suggest canary config:

```
route: primary -> mistral-xxl-q4_kv
fallback: -> mistral-33b-lite
canary: 10% traffic for 24h
```

priya_se: Pricing rough ballpark for Dedicated reserved for 2 weeks (config: 2xA100 equiv nodes, 20 qps target): ~$9k for the 2-week reservation + ~$1.5k for storage & ops. If they want 24/7 capacity scaling add ~25%. Final quote from finance.

jamie_sales: Nice — we need a quick checklist of what to ask the customer and internal owners. Can someone draft a short preflight?

priya_se: I'll draft preflight. Short list: 1) artifact (GGUF + tokenizer.json), 2) sample prompt set + target RPS/SLOs, 3) confirm data residency/PHI, 4) KMS key ARN + IP allowlist, 5) export control attestation, 6) desired rollout date.

elena_sec: Add: requested retention period for logs/outputs and whether they want PII scrubbing. If any regulatory healthcare data: we require Private deployment or a signed BA.

deploy-bot: [CI] model-scan job started for job_id=ms-3314456789-1 (status: queued) :gear:

marco_infra: I'll take the GGUF conversion if they share it. If they can't share weights (privacy), we can run a remote scan session — they upload to a presigned S3 we control and we run tests under NDA.

jamie_sales: Awesome. I'll coordinate with Lyric and ask for the artifact + attestation. Can we have an internal sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to finalize the SOW and estimate?

priya_se: 10:30am PT works for me. Marco/Elena/Rachel?

marco_infra: +1.

elena_sec: free then.

rachel_legal: I can join if needed, otherwise I'll review the draft SOW asynchronously. :thumbsup:

jamie_sales: Great — I'll set up the calendar and drop the customer asks in the doc. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
